def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    row_lines = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep = grid[row_lines[0]][0] if row_lines else grid[0][col_lines[0]]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_lines + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_lines + [w]
    out=[]
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        y0,y1=row_bounds[ri]+1,row_bounds[ri+1]
        outrow=[]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            x0,x1=col_bounds[ci]+1,col_bounds[ci+1]
            n=sum(grid[y][x] not in (bg,sep) for y in range(y0,y1) for x in range(x0,x1))
            outrow.append(1 if n==2 else bg)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out
